title: Application of Inpainting Methods for the Improvement of STEM-Based Time-Resolved Elemental Mapping
content: In situ electron microscopy has seen rapid growth due to the availability of commercial platforms that enable the analysis of microscopic processes under external stimuli [1]. However, compositional analysis during in situ experiment using complementary spectroscopy methods such as energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) had only seen limited application due to the acquisition times needed for spatially resolved mapping.
